_comment: Permissions for the 04:00 simulation agent ONLY. Loaded by run_sim_night.ps1 with
`--settings <this file>`. Nothing in the repository loads it on its own, so an
interactive session at the repository root is unaffected.
Why it exists (author ruling 2026-10-16, PLAN-2026-10-16 5.1): the outreach agent
starts in 07-outreach\, whose .claude\settings.json allows Python. The sim agent
starts at the repository root, whose .claude\settings.json allows nothing, so
under acceptEdits every python call was refused (2026-10-15 on Sonnet, 2026-10-16
on Opus). The author chose to keep the sim agent's permissions inside its own
folder rather than widen the root settings.
The real guard is still the brief and the fact that this agent has no key, no
token and no git. The deny list below is belt and braces. Paths are relative to
the working directory, which the launcher sets to the repository root.
Edit(path) rules cover every file-editing tool, Write included; the CLI warns if
a Write(path) rule is added, so do not add one.
<this file>` ran `python --version` at the repository root and printed 3.14.3.
